title: Use a reporting skill to create complex Spreadsheets in Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets)

chapters.title: Introduction to advanced spreadsheets and reporting app
Creating a new spreadsheet with the agent
Watching the agent build the dashboard
How to access and use the app

features.name: Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting App
features.description: An app for Business Central where you build spreadsheets connected with Business Central data. It comes with 15 built-in generic skills like executive summaries, GL exception dashboard, ratio dashboard, and budget versus actual.
caveats: Requires bring your own key API key from ChatGPT, Claude or other providers to use the agent

features.name: AI-powered Reporting Skills
features.description: Instructions for AI to build reports and dashboards. Skills provide a modern templating approach where users can specify what they want a report to contain without needing to save templates manually.

features.name: Built-in Skill Templates
features.description: The app comes with 15 different generic skills including executive summaries, GL exception dashboard, driver BI ratio dashboard, budget versus actual, and benchmarking dashboards.

features.name: Agent-driven Spreadsheet Building
features.description: An agent works with the spreadsheet to build complex layouts with KPI boxes, financial charts, and analysis sections. Users can provide specific instructions or let the agent use the skill defaults.

features.name: Bring Your Own Key Support
features.description: Users can bring their own API key from ChatGPT, Claude, or other supported providers to use the agent functionality.
caveats: Required to use the agent functionality
